name: ContextSniper
description: Local code search and exact-replacement edit tools backed by ContextSniper.

contextsniper_search_code.description: Search source, tests, docs, and release notes. content_excerpt is exact editable file text for edit replacement context; do not re-read files already returned with usable snippets.

contextsniper_edit_file.description: Edit source/doc files through exact replacement. Build old_string from exact ContextSniper search snippets; if exact text is still missing after search retry, use a narrow read.

contextsniper_index_codebase.description: Warm or report workspace indexing state.

repoRoot.description: Path to the ContextSniper repository. Auto-detected when omitted.

workspaceRoot.description: Default workspace root for code search/edit. Defaults to OpenClaw's current working directory.

runtimeDir.description: Runtime directory for local ContextSniper/AGFS processes. Defaults to ~/.cache/contextsniper-openclaw-plugin.

autoStart.description: Start ContextSniper/AGFS when OpenClaw loads the plugin if the backend is not already healthy.

autoStop.description: Stop services started by this plugin when OpenClaw unloads it.

startWaitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for ContextSniper backend health during startup.

injectCodePolicy.description: Inject ContextSniper code-search/edit policy into code-like prompts.

readToolPolicy.description: Controls native read handling. advisory leaves native read available; guard blocks native read.

filterEnabled.description: Enable native read and exec filtering through ContextSniper.

filterNativeRead.description: Rewrite long native read results to filtered L0 files when ContextSniper classifies them as filterable.

filterNativeExec.description: Wrap whitelisted native exec commands so long output is filtered before reaching the model.

accountId.description: ContextSniper account id for backend requests. Defaults to CONTEXTSNIPER_ACCOUNT_ID or acct-demo.

userId.description: ContextSniper user id for backend requests. Defaults to CONTEXTSNIPER_USER_ID or u-openclaw.

agentId.description: ContextSniper agent id for backend requests. Defaults to CONTEXTSNIPER_AGENT_ID or openclaw.

sessionId.description: Optional ContextSniper session id for backend requests.
